versions.changelog:
Initial release of hushh-one-pkm bridging Hussh One PKM consent to OpenClaw:

- Enables OpenClaw agents to access Hussh One user PKM data via the Hussh MCP bridge.
- Provides dynamic scope discovery, explicit user consent handling, and consent polling workflow.
- Enforces strict privacy boundaries: no token leaks, no bypassing consent, and limited data handling.
- Supports developer-token authentication and local/hosted MCP deployment modes.
- Includes best practices and restrictions for scope requests and data use.
